the mechanisms of glauc­ omatous optic neuropathv are still not fully understood, but that the available data support a model in which elevated lOP causes a progressive loss of axons and their myelin sheaths, and that this loss is caused by mechanical deformation of the axons and myelin sheaths.

the damage is not a simple consequence of pressure alone.
